fields.climate: tropical marine; little seasonal temperature variation
fields.terrain: flat with a few hills; scant vegetation
fields.hazards: hurricanes; lies outside the Caribbean hurricane belt and is rarely threatened
fields.resources: NEGL; white sandy beaches foster tourism
fields.exports: tobacco, gas turbines, refined petroleum, steam turbines, heating machinery
fields.languages: Papiamento (official) (a creole language that mixes Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, English, French, African languages, and Arawak) 69.4%, Spanish 13.7%, English (widely spoken) 7.1%, Dutch (official)…
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 75.3%, Protestant 4.9% (includes Methodist 0.9%, Adventist 0.9%, Anglican 0.4%, other Protestant 2.7%), Jehovah's Witness 1.7%, other 12%, none 5.5%, unspecified 0.5%

system.text: parliamentary democracy; part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands

fields.legal: civil law system based on the Dutch civil code
